meta.title: Word Sets for Beach Day
meta.textType: a new word from a word set

paragraphs: Posted by Lily. The Explorers plan a picnic at the beach, and we made word sets for the day. A set is a group of words about one topic. We will go by bus, and it will be a hot day. Each set has a few old words and one new word. Mia wrote the old words, and I wrote the new words in red.

The first set has the words for fruit. It has the words apple, banana, orange, and grapes. The new word is melon. A melon is a big round fruit with a hard skin and a sweet, wet inside. We usually eat melon in cold pieces on a hot day. May likes grapes the most. I drew a small melon next to the word, and Mia colored it green. The picnic will be a lot of fun. Leo says that a melon is the best fruit for a picnic.

The second set has the words for egg dishes. It has the words fried egg, egg roll, and egg rice. The new word is boiled. A boiled egg is an egg that is cooked in hot water with its shell on. A dish is a kind of food that you cook, and a boiled egg is an easy dish. May wants to make ten boiled eggs for our picnic. Boiled eggs are easy to carry.

The third set has the words for things that we bring to the beach. It has the words hat, towel, and sunscreen. There are two new words in this set, and they are surfboard and wallet. A surfboard is a long flat board that people use on the waves. We do not have a surfboard, but a coach can lend one to us. Leo wants to try it one day. A wallet is a small flat case for money and cards. We bring a wallet only for the bus fare.

Grace read our word sets, and she sent us a message from Singapore. She wrote, "Melon, picnic, and surfboard are international words." International means that people in many countries know the word. Teacher Kim said, "A word book is a good friend for any traveler."
We looked at our word sets again. Which set do you like best? Add your own words to a set, and check them with a friend.
text.summary: Lily writes about word sets for a beach day. A fruit set gets the new word melon, a set of egg dishes gets boiled, and a beach set gets surfboard and wallet. A message from Grace shows that some words are international.
